cases.source_reference: UI-02 labels and menu* actions; editor.ts AnnotationTool and Annotation
cases.fixture: Synthetic 400x300 image and one point sequence for arrow, rectangle, ellipse and pen.
cases.trigger: Create each tool's annotation through onAnnotationCreate, then select and edit it.
cases.target_observation_needed: Record editing handles, keyboard interactions, selection behavior and persistence for each shape.
cases.ferby_observation_needed: Record emitted Annotation values and onAnnotationSelect behavior for each tool.
cases.acceptance_rule: Compare geometry, selection and persistence only with separately recorded target observations.
cases.limitations: The contract defines data shapes and callbacks, not rendering, editing or persistence.

cases.source_reference: UI-02 and UI-03 Text/Counter labels; editor.ts Annotation text and counter fields
cases.fixture: Synthetic image with text and counter annotations, including empty text and repeated counters.
cases.trigger: Create text and counter annotations, then apply text/correction controls.
cases.target_observation_needed: Record formatting, empty-input behavior and counter sequence rules.
cases.ferby_observation_needed: Record emitted text/counter fields and selection behavior.
cases.acceptance_rule: Compare literal values and sequence behavior only after target capture.
cases.limitations: No text formatting or counter allocation function is declared in the named contract.

cases.fixture: Synthetic annotations with color, strokeWidth and opacity boundary values.
cases.target_observation_needed: Record available styles, defaults and whether styles are per-object or global.
cases.ferby_observation_needed: Record AnnotationStyle values emitted for each object.
cases.acceptance_rule: Compare style values and scope only to measured target behavior.
cases.limitations: The contract does not validate ranges or define style defaults.

cases.fixture: Synthetic image with an interior crop rectangle and reset/cut-out cancellation paths.
cases.trigger: Crop, cut out, reset selection and reset crop in sequence.
cases.target_observation_needed: Record restoration, selection bounds and destructive versus non-destructive results.
cases.ferby_observation_needed: Record image dimensions and annotation callback state around each action.
cases.acceptance_rule: Compare dimensions, restoration and cancellation only against recorded target behavior.
cases.limitations: The named editor contract has no crop or image-document operation.

cases.fixture: Synthetic image with two annotations followed by undo, redo and merge attempts.
cases.trigger: Create, undo, redo and rasterize annotations, including a branch after undo.
cases.target_observation_needed: Record undo scope, branch behavior and rasterization effects.
cases.ferby_observation_needed: Record callback sequence and resulting annotation list.
cases.acceptance_rule: Compare snapshot and rasterization behavior only after target observations exist.
cases.limitations: No history or rasterization API is present in the named contract.

cases.source_reference: UI-02/UI-03/UI-12 zoom, fit, 100%, selection and mouse-wheel affordances
cases.fixture: Synthetic 400x300 image with a known annotation point and selection rectangle.
cases.trigger: Apply zoom in/out, fit, 100%, selection and wheel-direction variants.
cases.target_observation_needed: Record scale, mapped coordinates, selection corners and keyboard/mouse behavior.
cases.ferby_observation_needed: Record point/rectangle values passed through EditorViewProps callbacks.
cases.acceptance_rule: Compare coordinate mapping and interaction behavior only to recorded target results.
cases.limitations: EditorViewProps contains no zoom or viewport callback, so UI integration is unproven.
